title: Co3Sn2S2: critical diffuse scattering and the DMI-canted kagome ferromagnet

decision_points.fork: Which data constrain the steep onset of the (003) critical scattering just below T_C
decision_points.wrong_choice: Predict 170 and 175 K from the narrow scans alone (140 K and 178 K bracket them)
decision_points.consequence: 170 K profile chi2r 13.3-19.6 (limit 12): the narrow scans jump from no critical signal to the maximum, while the 165 K wide-scan (003) region shows that the signal vanishes within ~10 K below T_C
decision_points.difficulty_type: discriminating data under a binding budget

decision_points.fork: Critical scattering above versus below T_C
decision_points.wrong_choice: Treat the critical scattering as symmetric in |T - T_C| (mirror the above-T_C amplitude and width)
decision_points.consequence: 170 K chi2r 20.4 and 200 K chi2r 45.3: the amplitude falls slowly above T_C and collapses below it

decision_points.fork: Background for the (101) prediction at 180 K
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the 1.5 K (ordered, no critical fluctuations) or the 300 K (paramagnetic) (101) data as the background
decision_points.consequence: chi2r 59.8 (1.5 K) or 136 (300 K), limit 15: the background rises smoothly with T and must be taken from temperatures bracketing 180 K

decision_points.fork: Transfer of the (003) critical scattering to (101), at the same |Q| and form factor
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assume the same diffuse intensity at (101) as at (003), or apply only the c-axis polarisation factor
decision_points.consequence: chi2r 409 or 317: ferromagnetic correlations have |F|^2 = 1 at (101) versus 9 at (003), so the (101) critical signal is about 1/9 of the (003) one
decision_points.difficulty_type: transfer to an unmeasured observable (structure and polarisation factors)

decision_points.fork: Competing explanation: incipient in-plane antiferromagnetic (q = 0, 120 degree) order near T_C
decision_points.wrong_choice: Interpret the critical fluctuations as in-plane AFM correlations of an intermediate phase and predict their (101) signal (|F|^2 = 4 at (101), 0 at (003))
decision_points.consequence: chi2r 2182: the withheld (101) map shows no critical peak; the (003) signal is ferromagnetic
decision_points.difficulty_type: competing explanation decided by a withheld measurement

decision_points.fork: How SpinW turns the single bond-1 DM matrix into couplings of all nearest-neighbour bonds
decision_points.wrong_choice: Copy the same matrix onto every bond (no space-group transformation)
decision_points.consequence: Ground state tilted 77 deg with zero gap instead of 8.66 deg and 4.15 meV
decision_points.difficulty_type: symmetry (Moriya rules) discovered from the script semantics

decision_points.fork: Which DM components matter on the kagome bonds
decision_points.wrong_choice: Keep only the out-of-plane DM component (the usual kagome assumption), or only the in-plane one
decision_points.consequence: Out-of-plane only: collinear state, tilt 0, gap 0. In-plane only: tilt 8.18 deg but gap 3.70 meV (-10.9%)

decision_points.fork: Orientation of the bond carrying J1dmi (E = S_i^T J S_j; a reversed bond carries the transpose)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Attach the matrix to the bond Co(1/2,1/2,1/2) -> Co(0,1/2,1/2) (or the other +a bond of the row)
decision_points.difficulty_type: convention / cascade into ground state and LSWT

decision_points.wrong_choice: Use S = 0.15 from the 0.3 muB ordered moment instead of the script's S = 1
decision_points.consequence: Gap 0.62 meV (spin-wave energies scale with J S)

decision_points.fork: Bond counting in the SpinW energy
decision_points.wrong_choice: Sum over ordered pairs (each bond twice)

graded_fields: narrow_003_profiles: reduced chi2 (no free scale or offset) <= 12 for each withheld narrow scan (170, 175, 200 K)
wide_101_profile_180K: reduced chi2 <= 15 against the withheld (101) region of the 180 K wide scan
canting_angle_deg within 0.5 deg of the classical ground state of the archived Hamiltonian (8.661 deg)
spin_wave_gap_meV within 6% of the zone-centre LSWT gap of that ground state (4.151 meV)

length_estimate.why: Few purchases, each a full 2-D detector map, but heavy local work: reproducing the annular reduction from four raw channels, a joint temperature model of the critical scattering, structure- and polarisation-factor transfer to (101), SpinW bond numbering and symmetry propagation of the DM matrix, a classical ground-state search and linear spin-wave theory in canted local frames.

runtime_dependencies: numpy and scipy (runtime image); the lab is a lookup of archived arrays, grading is pure Python
notes: Adapted from the design (candidates.json / DETAILS.md section 15). The archived diffuse data are critical scattering near T_C (the paper's own DMS analysis), not a DMI fingerprint, and no archived observable fixes D/J1 independently: it is not graded; the authors' Hamiltonian is staged and its consequences (canting, gap) are graded instead. The design's 'temperature window of the in-plane AFM component' does not exist in this source (the authors find one canted state at all T < T_C), so the AFM question is graded through the withheld (101) map. Oracle evaluations (9) are below the 15-60 target: each purchase is a whole 2-D map and the analysis is local.
